title: "Is Your Profile Underperforming?" — the niche's biggest proven ad
note: 191 days live, 510,116 EU reach — the hardest public number in the niche. Mechanism: a neutral diagnostic question instead of an insult, then 'data-driven profile review' as the free first step. Proof that the compliance-safe variant out-delivers the personal-attributes one.

title: SWAY — longest-living ad in the niche (197 days)
note: Running since 2026-02-17. Mechanism: rate → fix → generate bundle in one sentence ('rates your profile, polishes your photos, delivers top-tier hinge prompts'). Opens with a personal-attributes question we must not copy — study the offer stack, not the hook.

title: "You're not ugly. Your photos are just terrible."
note: 185 days live, 50k EU reach; runs as a persistent 5-ad set (sister ads at 175–184 days). Mechanism: insult-then-absolve — the blame moves from the man to his photos, 'no fake filters, no weird AI look' answers the likeness objection in-copy. Second-person appearance framing = Meta policy risk we do not copy.

title: "Better Photos. More Matches." — the clean variant
note: 175 days live, 61k EU reach. Mechanism: same photos-are-the-problem angle compressed to four beats — 'No studio. No cringe. Just more right swipes.' Closest existing ad to our voice rules; the benchmark to beat with coached-pose + free-check.

title: "Same face. 10x the matches." — Roast's top ad by impressions
note: 131 days live; #1 on Roast's page when sorted by impressions. Mechanism: third-person coworker-gatekeeping story + a phone-screenshot IMAGE of a full Hinge match list as the creative — social proof shown, not claimed. Low-fi static beats their polished video. The '10x' multiplier is an invented stat we never copy.

title: "If you're between 25 and 34 and can't get more than 1 match a week"
note: 119 days live. Mechanism: explicit age-bracket callout of exactly our ICP + 'it's not your face, it's your photos' reframe + free 2-minute first step. Interesting: qualifying the audience in copy instead of only in targeting.

title: "We are looking for 30 guys who open Tinder and get zero matches"
note: 107 days live. Mechanism: casting-call format — scarcity and selection without a fake countdown. The viewer applies rather than buys. A borrowable third-person structure.

title: ReGen control copy — one text, ~98 video variants
note: 54 days live and replicated across ~98 active variants — scaling by replication, not by one old ad. Mechanism: benefit inventory in plain third person ('no photographer, no outfit planning, no asking a friend'), Meta-safe throughout. The compliance template for app-install copy in this niche.

title: "She swiped left before she even got to your bio" — Photoshoot Dating
note: 43 days live — the veteran on ROAST's second page while its 16-day video wave is still testing. Mechanism: the 100-ms-decision moment dramatized ('girls decide in half a second and it's your photos making the call'), then 'that part's fixable'. Same territory as our locked line 'She decided in 100 ms.'
